title: Fast and genuinely cheap
body: Got it on *737# in under five minutes and the 1.33% monthly rate is the best I've found. Repaid over 12 months with no hidden charges.

title: Reliable
body: Used it twice now. Approval is instant if your salary comes through GTBank. Wish the limit were higher for me.

title: Good for non-customers
body: I don't bank with them but still got ₦1.2m over 18 months. The management fee is on the high side but service was excellent.

title: Convenient but watch the rate
body: Super easy in the app, but the short-term rate is steep. Fine for emergencies if you repay quickly.

title: Money in minutes
body: Specta really does disburse fast and I'm not even a Sterling customer. Clear terms upfront.
